windworn_scroll.name: Windworn Scroll
windworn_scroll.lore: Edges frayed by wind, ink faded but legible. Signed by R.

dawn_etched_scroll.name: Dawn-Etched Scroll
dawn_etched_scroll.lore: Letters seem to glow faintly when held to morning light.

tide_sealed_scroll.name: Tide-Sealed Scroll
tide_sealed_scroll.lore: Wrapped in oilcloth, smells faintly of salt. Sanctuary mark on the seal.

iron_seal_scroll.name: Iron-Seal Scroll
iron_seal_scroll.lore: Pressed shut with a black wax seal stamped with a closed fist.

void_etched_scroll.name: Void-Etched Scroll
void_etched_scroll.lore: The text shifts when you're not looking at it directly.

ember_tongue_scroll.name: Ember Tongue Scroll
ember_tongue_scroll.lore: Charred along one edge, as if it had recently spoken.

shieldbearers_scroll.name: Shieldbearer's Scroll
shieldbearers_scroll.lore: Bound with leather and a small iron buckle. Heavier than it should be.

caligo_vellum.name: Caligo Vellum
caligo_vellum.lore: The vellum is darker than dye should make it. Reading it indoors feels colder than the room.

starlit_codex.name: Starlit Codex
starlit_codex.lore: Pinpricks of light dot the cover. They aren't the same constellations twice.

broken_communion_scroll.name: Broken Communion Scroll
broken_communion_scroll.lore: Half the page is missing. The remaining half writhes when held.

lumen_folio.name: Lumen Folio
lumen_folio.lore: Bound in pale leather. The pages give off their own faint light. When you open it, the room briefly forgets it has corners.

first_keepers_scroll.name: First Keeper's Scroll
first_keepers_scroll.lore: Heavier than it should be. Three sigils glow when held: a moon, a leaf, a chain.
